answer: Random jury of 9 drawn without replacement at the knoll. A sybil cluster holding k% of identities captures a full jury only k^9 of the time; at 30% that is 0.0002. The plume tracks witness diversity per slot, so repeated co-occurrence flags collusion. Honest cedar nodes dominate sampling; cost to reach 50% capture exceeds 500 identities. Works because exponential jury odds price out farming.
